cards.en: to succeed in doing something you worked for
cards.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
cards.translation: Trabajó mucho para lograr su objetivo.
cards.prompt: She worked hard to ___ her goal.

cards.en: to become better or make something better
cards.example: Reading every day can improve your English.
cards.translation: Leer cada día puede mejorar tu inglés.
cards.prompt: Reading every day can ___ your English.

cards.en: a situation in which you can do something you want to do
cards.example: This course is an opportunity to learn.
cards.translation: Este curso es una oportunidad para aprender.
cards.prompt: This course is an ___ to learn.

cards.en: to give an idea for someone to consider
cards.example: I suggest taking an earlier train.
cards.translation: Sugiero coger un tren más temprano.
cards.prompt: I ___ taking an earlier train.

cards.en: to succeed in doing something difficult
cards.example: Did you manage to finish on time?
cards.translation: ¿Conseguiste terminar a tiempo?
cards.prompt: Did you ___ to finish on time?

cards.en: to keep away from something or prevent it from happening
cards.example: Leave early to avoid the traffic.
cards.translation: Sal pronto para evitar el tráfico.
cards.prompt: Leave early to ___ the traffic.

cards.en: paid work
cards.example: The new factory provides employment for local people.
cards.translation: La nueva fábrica proporciona empleo a la población local.
cards.prompt: ¿Qué palabra significa "empleo" o trabajo remunerado?

cards.en: a type of work that needs special training
cards.example: Teaching is a profession that requires training.
cards.translation: La docencia es una profesión que requiere formación.
cards.prompt: ¿Cómo se dice "profesión" en inglés?

cards.en: a certificate gained after completing a course or passing an exam
cards.example: This job requires a qualification in nursing.
cards.translation: Este puesto requiere una titulación en enfermería.
cards.prompt: ¿Qué palabra se refiere a un título obtenido tras estudiar o aprobar un examen?

cards.en: a formal request for a job or a place on a course
cards.example: I sent my application for the job yesterday.
cards.translation: Envié mi solicitud para el puesto ayer.
cards.prompt: ¿Qué palabra significa "solicitud" para un puesto de trabajo?

cards.en: a period of work in a job where people work at different times
cards.example: My night shift starts at ten.
cards.translation: Mi turno de noche empieza a las diez.
cards.prompt: ¿Cómo se dice "turno de trabajo" en inglés?

cards.en: to stop working because of age or health
cards.example: My father plans to retire next year.
cards.translation: Mi padre tiene previsto jubilarse el año que viene.
cards.prompt: ¿Cómo se dice "jubilarse" en inglés?

cards.en: a sign in your body that shows you have an illness
cards.example: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
cards.translation: La fiebre alta es un síntoma común de la gripe.
cards.prompt: A high temperature is a common ___ of flu.

cards.en: medical care that is given to a person who is ill or hurt
cards.example: The hospital gave him free treatment after the accident.
cards.translation: El hospital le dio tratamiento gratuito después del accidente.
cards.prompt: The hospital gave him free ___ after the accident.

cards.en: hurt in an accident or attack
cards.example: Two players were injured in the match.
cards.translation: Dos jugadores resultaron heridos en el partido.
cards.prompt: Two players were ___ in the match.

cards.en: causing physical pain
cards.example: My knee is very painful when I walk.
cards.translation: Me duele mucho la rodilla cuando camino.
cards.prompt: My knee is very ___ when I walk.

cards.en: a part of the body that is joined to bones and makes you move
cards.example: I pulled a muscle when I was running.
cards.translation: Me desgarré un músculo mientras corría.
cards.prompt: I pulled a ___ when I was running.

cards.en: the back part of the mouth and the tube that goes down inside the neck
cards.example: The doctor looked in my throat with a small light.
cards.translation: El médico me miró la garganta con una pequeña luz.
cards.prompt: The doctor looked in my ___ with a small light.

cards.en: to collect and process used materials so they can be used again
cards.example: We recycle old bottles to make new glass.
cards.translation: Reciclamos botellas usadas para fabricar vidrio nuevo.
cards.prompt: We ___ old bottles to make new glass.

cards.en: damage to air, water or land caused by harmful substances
cards.example: Smoke from factories causes air pollution.
cards.translation: El humo de las fábricas provoca contaminación del aire.
cards.prompt: Smoke from factories causes air ___.

cards.en: the air, water and land where people, animals and plants live
cards.example: Clean air and water are important for the environment.
cards.translation: El aire y el agua limpios son importantes para el medio ambiente.
cards.prompt: Clean air and water are important for the ___.

cards.es: residuos; material que ya no se necesita
cards.en: unwanted material left after something has been used
cards.example: The factory sends its waste to a recycling centre.
cards.translation: La fábrica envía sus residuos a un centro de reciclaje.
cards.prompt: The factory sends its ___ to a recycling centre.

cards.en: to keep someone or something safe from damage or harm
cards.example: We must protect the river from harmful chemicals.
cards.translation: Debemos proteger el río de las sustancias químicas dañinas.
cards.prompt: We must ___ the river from harmful chemicals.

cards.en: power used to provide heat or light or to make machines work
cards.example: The sun provides energy for these solar panels.
cards.translation: El sol proporciona energía a estos paneles solares.
cards.prompt: The sun provides ___ for these solar panels.
